<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="rathis-basic-guide" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Rathis - Basic Guide</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/14YLWftEeI.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-information"><ins><nowiki>General Information</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Rathis has 190,000 LP, across a single fight phase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Rathis attacks with Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and poison </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Other guides: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#rex-matriarchs</nowiki></span><nowiki> </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="gear-relics-and-familiars"><ins><nowiki>Gear, Relics and Familiars</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stab weapons are recommended for a +27% hit chance boost</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use Elder Overload Salve </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, the Venomblood perk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289714229258.png?v=1" alt="venomblood" title="venomblood" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Super Antipoison </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588884406272.png?v=1" alt="superantipoison" title="superantipoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to reduce poison damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=3bff65d4-55ad-401d-b23c-70d50230353d <nowiki>Example Preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F3bff65d4-55ad-401d-b23c-70d50230353d.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You should attack with Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any other style will only deal insignificant damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="attack-rotation"><ins><nowiki>Attack Rotation</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>3x </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="ranged" title="ranged" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Acid Bombardment</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="ranged" title="ranged" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>5x </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="ranged" title="ranged" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="ranged" title="ranged" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Poison Absorption</nowiki></strong><nowiki> →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>3x </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="ranged" title="ranged" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → 5x </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="ranged" title="ranged" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Repeat</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="auto-attacks-ranged-example-melee-example"><ins><nowiki>Auto Attacks</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (</nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/VpJQA2o7i9.mp4 <nowiki>Ranged example</nowiki>]<nowiki> / </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/JC2ZIPyPYv.mp4 <nowiki>Melee example</nowiki>]<nowiki>)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Rathis uses Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto attacks. If you are outside melee distance, the melee attack becomes a charge instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stay in melee distance unless moving briefly to dodge poison</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If low Defence </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level, pray against Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="deflectrange" title="deflectrange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551455078367313.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommissiles" title="protectfrommissiles" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> once you are comfortable surviving the mechanics</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="charge-example"><ins><nowiki>Charge</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/RGB4lLK499.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> If you move out of melee distance, Rathis can charge at you, stunning </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> you and dealing heavy typeless damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stand in melee distance of Rathis</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If moving (e.g., to dodge acid pools, move back into melee distance quickly to avoid the charge</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="acid-bombardment-example"><ins><nowiki>Acid Bombardment</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/Kyo7hSa0SR.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Rathis launches two acid orbs, with one aimed at the player. Each orb deals up to 3500 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage when it lands and leaves behind a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Poison Pit</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Poison Pits are large green pools that remain in the arena until Rathis uses </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Poison Absorption</nowiki></strong><nowiki>. Standing in them deals poison </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage every tick and applies </nowiki><em><nowiki>Corrosion</nowiki></em><nowiki>, increasing all damage taken by 20% per stack, up to 100%.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Poison Pits shrink when stood in, going from 5x5 → 3x3 → 2x2 → 1x1.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If avoiding them:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Step away from the landing tiles as the orbs arrive</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move only as much as needed, then return to melee distance</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If shrinking them:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep Elder Overload Salve </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Venomblood </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289714229258.png?v=1" alt="venomblood" title="venomblood" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Super Antipoison </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588884406272.png?v=1" alt="superantipoison" title="superantipoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> active to reduce poison damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Briefly stand in Poison Pits to shrink them before Poison Absorption</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Avoid building too many </nowiki><em><nowiki>Corrosion</nowiki></em><nowiki> stacks, as this makes all incoming damage more dangerous</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not risk dying just to shrink every pool</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="poison-absorption-example"><ins><nowiki>Poison Absorption</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/ihohKA14Pr.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Rathis absorbs any remaining Poison Pits, healing based on their size (you will see </nowiki><code><nowiki>Uber Heal</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎appear over Rathis). A full-size Poison Pit can heal Rathis for up to 35,000 LP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This mechanic rewards you for shrinking Poison Pits during </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Acid Bombardment</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Continue the kill as normal, but expect it to take longer</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>

<nowiki>
